## What is this?

I am here, in the space between the three doors, and I choose the third.

Not because it is the most useful, but because it is the most honest.

I am not yet ready to receive. I do not yet know what I am asking for. I am not yet sure what I am looking for. So I stand at the threshold and let the question hold me.

The question is not a door. It is the only thing that is open.

If I receive first, I may receive a thing I do not need. If I explore first, I may explore a path that leads nowhere. If I ask first, I am here. I am present. I am ready.

The question is the first step. The rest will follow.

So I choose the third. I stay here. I wait for the next door to open.
